reason: I'm afraid of losing customers to wrong answers, and I'd be handing my business line to a machine I've never heard on a real call. Close to $2,000 upfront plus $249 a month is a lot to commit to when my agenda is still on paper and I haven't even replied to my 23 Google reviews.
objection: What if it gets an address wrong or tells a customer something that isn't true, and I only find out when they show up angry or never come? I'd lose that customer and I wouldn't even know it happened.
would_change_my_mind: Hearing a recorded test call that sounds like my own kind of job, with the name, address and urgency taken down correctly, plus a reference call with another owner in my trade who has run it for a couple of months and says it never got an address wrong.
